pkgmetadata.longdescription: The ::gentoo ebuild with three additions: the geolocation plugin (receives the phone's location, kdeconnect-android MR !529, and offers it as NMEA on localhost and on D-Bus); remote connect (custom devices by IP address or host name, e.g. over Tailscale, retried with backoff while a paired device is unreachable, dead links dropped after 60 s, a settings section in the app); and the upstream TCP keepalive tuning from master. Dropped again once upstream has all three.
